external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Every year, Protyre works closely with TyreSafe to raise awareness of the importance of tyre maintenance and the dangers of defective and illegal tyres. TyreSafe is the authority and first point of reference for tyre safety issues.

Protyre's Motor Ombudsman accreditation ensures you will receive a professional, transparent, fair and reliable service. The Motor Ombudsman provide the most comprehensive and detailed Codes of Practice for the automotive sector.

Today, Micheldever Group is the largest independent wholesaler, distributor and retailer of tyres in the UK, selling over six million tyres nationwide, (20 percent of the total UK market) every year. Micheldever Group is managed by a team headed by Graham Mitchell and is part of Sumitomo Rubber Industries Ltd.
